% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\rawhtml|<tp-mathfield label="Formula" value="E = mc^2" clearable=""></tp-mathfield>|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/math/math.js";
import "/components/mathfield/mathfield.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-mathfield");
element1.setAttribute("label", "Formula");
element1.setAttribute("value", "E = mc^2");
element1.setAttribute("clearable", "");
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Inline in prose
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Einstein's equation \rawhtml*|<tp-mathfield name="energy" value="E = mc^2"></tp-mathfield>| relates mass and energy.
\end{document}

% !tp-example Inline named field
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Value: \rawhtml*|<tp-mathfield name="identifier" value="E = mc^2" placeholder="Enter a value"></tp-mathfield>|
\end{document}
